part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `do_write_float` (include/fmt/format.h:6471): in the fixed-notation branch with a fractional part (`1234e-2 -> 12.34`), the padded-size computation counted digit-group separators over the entire significand (`significand_size`) instead of just the integral part (`exp`). Grouping only applies to digits before the decimal point, so for localized output the computed size was too large, and `write_padded` inserted extra padding — most visibly when the integer part is zero (e.g. `0.295` with a comma-grouping locale).

The one-line change to `grouping.count_separators(exp)` matches the upstream fix (fmtlib/fmt#3272). Verified with a locale-facet reproduction (aligned output now) and the full container test suite: all 20 test suites pass, including `format-test`, `xchar-test`, and `printf-test`.
